papers.title: Beam Model Technical Report
papers.desc: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.

papers.title: Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion
papers.desc: Latent generative models typically rely on three separate networks: an encoder that tokenizes pixels, a generator that models the latent distribution, and a decoder that maps latents back to pixels.

papers.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
papers.desc: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior.

papers.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
papers.desc: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling.

papers.title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
papers.desc: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models.

papers.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
papers.desc: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN).

papers.title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
papers.desc: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks.

papers.title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
papers.desc: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code.

papers.title: Innata-0: A Native Embodied World System with Model-Agent Co-Design
papers.desc: The physical world is open-ended, dynamic, and partially observable.

papers.title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
papers.desc: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
papers.desc: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks.

papers.title: Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author
papers.desc: Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer "who wrote this?" at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human, often exactly who.

papers.title: HEP-Ex-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Performance in High Energy Physics Experiment Data Analyses with Sealed Worlds
papers.desc: Agentic systems are increasingly being explored for automating experimental high-energy physics measurements, but the correctness of their results can today be reliably evaluated only via extensive expert review.

papers.title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
papers.desc: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return.

papers.title: CCFinance: Reconstructing Financial News Samples from Web Archives
papers.desc: Proprietary news archives assign stories to firms, so reproducing a financial study often requires access to both the articles and the vendor's assignments.
